CREATURE.abyssal.description: The Abyssals are a very ancient aquatic people who have little affection for people on the surface. They reign supreme under the oceans and exact a heavy toll on all the navies of the world.
CREATURE.abyssal.teleportation.descripti: This teleports from one body of water to another
CREATURE.araigneegeante.description: A giant spider, with eyes shining like emeralds, weaves its silver web under the light of the moon. Its paws, as sharp as blades, crackle on the forest floor, causing the ground to tremble under its colossal weight..
CREATURE.araigneegeante.jetdetoile.descr: (Dexterity), paralyzed until a Strength roll is successful
CREATURE.arakneen.description: These creatures are created by giant spiders that transform their victims into nightmarish mutants. There is no known cure for this mutation.
CREATURE.arakneen.glaviotdetoile.descrip: (Dexterity or Melee), a spider web suffocates the character for one turn (this turn must be devoted to pulling out this web)
CREATURE.berserker.description: A berserker, his skin scarred from countless battles, wields a massive axe, his eyes burning with savage rage. Every cry he lets out shakes the ground, while his thirst for battle frightens even the bravest.
CREATURE.berserker.chargefurieuse.descri: (Dexterity or Melee) to any adjacent persone
CREATURE.blob.description: It is said that blobs are born under the laboratories of wizards and alchemists, when too many potions and failed experiments have mixed together over time. A blob has only one instinct: to feed.
CREATURE.brule.description: A burned one, his body deformed by past flames, moves with agonizing slowness. The smell of ashes and burning flesh accompanies him, while every movement he makes creates a sinister grinding sound, testifying to eternal suffering.e.
CREATURE.changelin.description: These creatures from Ur-Hundun are used by the Elves of the Eastern Empire to replace key figures of their political rivals. Some changelings, however, manage to leave their original plane of their own accord to venture into the known world.
CREATURE.changelin.memeattaque.descripti: as the character targeted this turn
CREATURE.crapot.description: These humanoid amphibians live in fetid marshes and guard, often without knowing why, ancient ruins which hide both great treasures and terrible dangers.
CREATURE.crapotshaman.description: A toad shaman, his body covered in mystical symbols, holds a staff decorated with skulls and feathers. His eyes glow with ancient wisdom and an aura of magical power emanates from him, causing the surrounding air to chill.
CREATURE.crapotshaman.molard.description: (Dexterity) Hallucinations with disadvantages on all rolls
CREATURE.crapotshaman.croassementlugubre: returns 3 HP to any toad present
CREATURE.decapite.description: A decapitated one, a rusty ax firmly held in his hand, wanders aimlessly. Every movement of his headless body resonates with an eerie silence, bearing witness to a tragic and terrifying existence. His presence alone is enough to chill the blood of those who cross his path.
CREATURE.demondeguerre.description: A war demon, his body covered in scars from past battles, wields a massive warhammer, his laughter echoing across the battlefield. His fiery red eyes reflect an insatiable thirst for conflict, while each step he takes shakes the ground, announcing the imminent arrival of war.
CREATURE.demondelacorruption.description: A demon of corruption, his body distorted with marks of perversion, stands in the shadows, a sick smile on his face. His bloody red eyes glow with cruel malice, while an aura of decadence escapes from him, infecting everything around him.
CREATURE.demondelacorruption.zizanie.des: (Guts) attack a close or adjacent ally
CREATURE.dragongrincheux.description: A grumpy dragon, its scales bristling and its nostrils steaming, growls in its dark lair. His eyes flashing with anger, he growls at every intrusion, his tail lashing the air irritably, testifying to his constant sullen mood.
CREATURE.dragondesbrumes.description: A mist dragon, its ethereal body blending into the surrounding clouds, emerges with silent majesty. Its eyes, like beacons in the fog, shine with a mystical brilliance, while its breath releases a veil of mist, shrouding everything in supernatural mystery.
CREATURE.ecorche.description: A flayed one, his skin torn revealing grotesque musculature, moves with terrifying grace. His empty eyes stare at the horizon, while a permanent grin reveals sharp teeth, testifying to his insatiable thirst for pain and terror.
CREATURE.ecartele.description: A quartered one, his body torn and mutilated, drags himself in chains, each link resonating with his pain. His eyes, filled with pain and rage, stare at his opponents, while every movement he makes reveals supernatural strength, defying death itself.
CREATURE.ecartele.chaine.description: (Dexterity or Melee) can aim at distant targets
CREATURE.elfegardien.description: A guardian elf, his slender body wrapped in armor of leaves and vines, stands with quiet dignity. Its deep green eyes scan the forests it protects, while each movement it makes is in harmony with the surrounding nature, testifying to its sacred role as guardian.
CREATURE.elfegardien.dansedeguerre.descr: (Dexterity or Melee) to any adjacent enemy
CREATURE.elfe.description: An elf, her graceful figure silhouetted against the light of the moon, moves with supernatural agility through the forest. His emerald green eyes shine with ancient wisdom, while every gesture he makes is in harmony with the surrounding nature, testifying to his existence in symbiosis with the forest world.
CREATURE.epouvantail.description: A scarecrow, its body of straw and old clothes swaying gently in the wind, stands alone in a field. His eyes, two pieces of coal, seem to follow every movement, while his stitched smile testifies to a silent but disturbing presence.
(Guts) the character attacks an illusion during his turn
CREATURE.espritdesmaladies.description: A spirit of disease, its ethereal form pulsing with an unhealthy aura, floats through the air, leaving a trail of pestilence behind it. His eyes, two feverish lights, glow with perverse glee, while every movement he makes seems to spread disease and decay, testifying to his terrifying power over health and well-being.
CREATURE.espritdesmaladies.affaiblir.des: (Strength) disadvantage to all rolls until healed (one Strength roll/day allowed, character is healed if successful)
CREATURE.fantome.description: A ghost with eyes as fiery as embers, its icy cry echoes through the darkness, making even the bravest souls shiver. His ethereal presence, shrouded in a veil of terror, haunts every corner of the darkness.
CREATURE.fomore.description: A colossal fomorian, his storm ax roars with the fury of a thousand storms, each blow unleashing a devastating storm. His armor is as dark as the deepest night, and his gaze is as sharp as the wind of the storm he wields.
CREATURE.fomore.hachedestempetes.descrip: (Dexterity or Melee) attack all nearby targets
CREATURE.garde.description: A towering guard, his morningstar glows with a sinister radiance, each spike promising unimaginable pain. His determined gaze inspires respect, while his deadly weapon makes the hearts of the ill-intentioned tremble.
CREATURE.garde.renforts.description: d4 guards arrive in d4 turns
CREATURE.gardiendesforets.description: A guardian of the forests, his verdant aura mingles with the whispers of the trees, each leaf and blade of grass dancing as he passes. Its presence is as old as the forest itself, an unshakable shield against those who would seek to disrupt the natural balance.
CREATURE.gardiendesforets.piegederonce.d: (Dexterity) the victim is entangled until they make a successful Strength roll
CREATURE.gardiendepierre.description: A guardian of stone, his imposing stature is as unshakable as the mountain itself, his stone sword as sharp and merciless as the side of a cliff. His skin resembles raw granite, and every movement he makes resonates with the telluric Strength of the earth itself.
CREATURE.gargouille.description: A towering gargoyle, carved from gray stone, with ruby ​​eyes that glow with an evil glow. Its outstretched wings and sharp claws evoke a silent threat.
CREATURE.geant.description: A colossal giant, with skin like rough granite and eyes sparkling like two distant stars. His imposing stature and raw strength inspire both fear and respect.
CREATURE.geant.attraper.description: (Dexterity) the character is grabbed by the geant
CREATURE.golemdebronze.description: A bronze golem, its metallic surface gleaming in the light, emits a low growl with each movement. His imposing stature and massive fists are a display of raw power.
CREATURE.golemdebronze.claquerdesmains.d: (Strength) deafens until the end of the fight
CREATURE.goule.description: A sinister ghoul, with skin pale and cold as death, and eyes that glow with insatiable hunger. Its sharp claws and jaw distorted by sharp fangs inspire icy terror.
CREATURE.gremlin.description: A mischievous gremlin, small but agile, with eyes sparkling with mischief. Its scaly skin and clawed fingers are often the cause of mischievous pranks and mayhem.
CREATURE.gremlin.portepoisse.description: (Dexterity) an object you are carrying breaks
CREATURE.herautduchaos.description: A herald of Chaos, wielding a demonic blade that glows with a sinister glow. The edge of the sword seems to sing a melody of destruction, promising chaos and desolation to those who stand in its way.
CREATURE.herautduchaos.ouraganduchaos.de: (Dexterity or Melee) to all adjacent targetss
CREATURE.hurleur.description: A screamer with a piercing scream, his voice echoes like a terrifying echo through the darkness. Its appearance and heartbreaking cry are an omen of doom to those who cross its path.
CREATURE.liche.description: A terrifying lich, wielding a barbed sword that radiates an aura of death and desolation. His emaciated body and vacant gaze are a reminder of his unliving nature, while the barbed sword promises a painful end to his adversaries.
CREATURE.loupmeute.description: Wolves in packs, their bright eyes reflecting the glow of the moon. Their unified howl echoes through the night, a wild melody that speaks of the Strength of brotherhood and hunting as a group.
CREATURE.loupmeute.encercler.description: (Dexterity) all of the following Defense rolls are made with disadvantage
CREATURE.loupmeute.morsure.description: (Dexterity or Melee) every 2 points of damage, a wolf is eliminated
CREATURE.loupgarou.description: A fierce werewolf, his muscular form transforming under the glow of the full moon. His yellow eyes glow with savage hunger, while his sharp claws and fangs reveal the beast within him.
CREATURE.loupgarou.hurlement.description: (Guts) a character wounded by a werewolf must make a   successful Will roll, on a result of 1 the character becomes a werewolf the following night
CREATURE.loupgeant.description: A giant wolf, its imposing stature and thick fur evoke raw Strength. Its piercing eyes scan the horizon, while its deep growl echoes through the forest, announcing its dominant presence.
CREATURE.mangeurdame.description: A soul eater, his dark figure emanates an aura of despair. Its empty eyes suck life energy, while its presence evokes an insatiable hunger for the souls of the living.
CREATURE.mercenaire.description: A seasoned mercenary, wielding an imposing claymore that glows in the sun. His determined gaze and sharp blade are testimony to a warrior ready to face any challenge.
CREATURE.mercenairearbaletrier.descripti: A determined mercenary, carrying a heavy crossbow that promises silent death. His calculating gaze and deadly precision make him a formidable opponent on the battlefield.
CREATURE.mercenairesergent.description: A veteran mercenary, marked by the scars of many battles. His determined look and worn sword are a testament to a warrior who has survived many challenges and continues to fight.
CREATURE.mercenairesergent.esquive.descr: Disadvantage to attack the sergeant this turn
CREATURE.minotaure.description: A powerful minotaur, wielding a heavy club that evokes raw Strength. His fierce gaze and imposing stature, combined with the menacing club, make him a formidable opponent.
CREATURE.mignonduchaos.description: A imps of chaos, his small size contrasts with his aura of disorder. His eyes sparkling with mischief and his mischievous smile are often the source of unpredictable tricks.
CREATURE.molosse.description: An imposing hound, its powerful musculature and sharp jaw inspire fear. His intense gaze and thunderous bark are testimony to an unwavering guardian.
CREATURE.molosse.renverser.description: (Dexterity ou Strength) you end up on your butt
CREATURE.molossemecanique.description: A mechanical hound, its shiny metallic structure and mechanical rumbles inspire fear. Its luminous eyes and thunderous bark are testament to a steadfast guardian, programmed for protection.
CREATURE.momie.description: An ancient mummy, wrapped in time-worn wrappings. His empty gaze and slow gait speak of an eternal existence, while his silent presence whispers stories of a bygone era.
CREATURE.momieserviteur.description: A servant of a mummy, its worn wrappings envelop a silent body. His eternal dedication and silent presence are the testimony of a servant who continues to serve even after death.
a killed servant returns to life after 3 turns as long as the sovereign is not killed
CREATURE.nainmecontent.description: A disgruntled dwarf, his weathered face is furrowed in an expression of displeasure. His harsh gaze and shaggy beard are evidence of a dwarf who is unhappy with this turn of events.
CREATURE.nainveteran.description: A veteran dwarf, armed with a sturdy battle ax that glows in the light. His determined look and graying beard are a testament to a warrior who has survived many challenges and continues to fight with courage.
CREATURE.nainveteran.faucher.description: (Dexterity) you end up on your butts
CREATURE.necromant.description: A sinister necromancer, shrouded in dark robes, with eyes that glow with an unearthly glow. His quiet whisper and calculated gestures suggest a disturbing mastery of death magic.
CREATURE.nueederats.description: A swarm of rats, their glowing eyes reflecting the dim light of the sewers. Their incessant squeaking and coordinated movement are evidence of a creeping and insidious threat.
CREATURE.ogre.description: A massive ogre, his skin rough like raw stone, his eyes sparkling with malice and hunger. His presence is as terrifying as his insatiable appetite, making the ground tremble under his heavy footsteps.
CREATURE.ombreassassine.description: A murderous shadow armed with a scythe, its silhouette blends into the darkness, each movement a silent whisper in the night. His scythe, as dark as the night itself, slices the air with deadly precision, leaving a trail of silent terror in its wake.
CREATURE.paysanenerve.description: An angry peasant, his eyes sparkling with anger, his pitchfork brandished like a standard of revolt. His determination is as sharp as the tines of his pitchfork, and every word he speaks vibrates with the Strength of his frustration.
CREATURE.pieuvregeante.description: A giant octopus, its tentacles undulate with terrifying Strength, each sucker a dark abyss ready to swallow up anything that comes within its reach. Its massive body emerges from the depths, eclipsing the sun and plunging the surrounding waters into an eerie darkness.
CREATURE.pieuvregeante.attaquerlembarcat: sinks a boat after 3 attacks. Once at 0 HP, the octopus retreats
CREATURE.pirate.description: A daring pirate, his gaze is as sharp as the blade of his saber, each scar tells a story of battles and storms. Its laughter echoes across the waves, a challenge to the sea itself, while its black flag flutters proudly in the wind.
CREATURE.pirate.agilecommeunsinge.descri: can move twice aboard a ship
CREATURE.piratecapitaine.description: A ruthless pirate captain, his gaze is as hard as the steel of his saber, every order he gives carries the weight of life and death. His laughter resounds on the waves, a hymn to freedom and rebellion, while his ship cuts through the waters with unparalleled audacity.
roll a d6 when a character hits the captain, on a result of 1 or 2 another pirate takes the damage
CREATURE.ratlingbrigand.description: A ruffian ratling, his eyes glow with cunning malice, every movement he makes is quick and stealthy. His small stature is deceptive, as he wields his dagger with deadly precision, and his smirk is often the last thing his victims see.
CREATURE.ratlingillumine.description: An assassin ratling, his eyes shine with ancient wisdom, every word he speaks is charged with mysteries and knowledge. His small stature is shrouded in a mystical aura, and the secrets he holds are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
CREATURE.ratlingillumine.effluvesempoiss: (Strength) vomiting, disadvantage on attribute rolls this turn
CREATURE.rejetonduchaos.description: A warrior of Chaos, his body is a grotesque mosaic of mutations, each limb an embodiment of the madness of the chaos gods. Its laughter is a terrifying growl that resonates in the depths of the soul, sowing fear and despair in its wake.
CREATURE.requin.description: A terrifying shark, its streamlined body glides silently through the waters, each movement a deadly dance of grace and power. Its sharp teeth are blades of death, ready to tear apart anything unfortunate enough to cross its path.
CREATURE.requin.attirerequins.descriptio: d6 additional sharks in case of a successful attack
CREATURE.requingeant.description: A giant shark, its massive body dwarfs the sun underwater, each flap of its tail fin creates powerful waves. Its teeth, large as swords, are ready to tear flesh, and its fierce gaze is a constant reminder of the danger that lurks in the depths.
CREATURE.requingeant.avaler.description: (Dexterity) disadvantage underwater, you are in the shark's stomach
CREATURE.requingeant.entrainer.descripti: (Dexterity) with disadvantage underwater, the shark drags its victim with it and is out of reach after 3 turns
CREATURE.sangliergeant.description: A giant boar, its massive body is covered in bristling hair, each growl it emits makes the earth shake beneath its feet. His sword-sized tusks are ready to tear apart anything that dares oppose him, and his savage gaze is a constant reminder of nature's raw Strength.
CREATURE.sangrelinarcher.description:
A gorelin archer, his lean body a stealthy silhouette in the shadows, each arrow he shoots a deadly whistle through the air. His piercing gaze is as sharp as the tips of his arrows, and each movement he makes is a silent ballet of precision and speed.

Goreling are the result from an experiment carried out by sorcerers from the past. It is not a question of a people but of a disease. Anyone injured by a Goreling and who continues to kill turns into a Goreling at the next full moon. The victim loses his memory and only thinks of joining other bloodrels and continuing the massacre.
CREATURE.sangrelinbrute.description:
A Goreling brute, his massive body is a brutal Strength to fear, every blow he delivers is an earthquake. His thick skin is as hard as steel, and his savage gaze is a constant reminder of the fury that burns within him.

Goreling are the result from an experiment carried out by sorcerers from the past. It is not a question of a people but of a disease. Anyone injured by a Goreling and who continues to kill turns into a Goreling at the next full moon. The victim loses his memory and only thinks of joining other bloodrels and continuing the massacre.
CREATURE.sangrelinchef.description:
A Goreling leader, his gaze is as sharp as the edge of his blade, every order he gives carries the weight of life and death. His laughter echoes through the shadows, a hymn to domination and cruelty, as his clan gathers around him, ready to follow his orders without question.

Goreling are the result from an experiment carried out by sorcerers from the past. It is not a question of a people but of a disease. Anyone injured by a Goreling and who continues to kill turns into a Goreling at the next full moon. The victim loses his memory and only thinks of joining other bloodrels and continuing the massacre.
CREATURE.scorpiongeant.description: A giant scorpion, its armored body glows sinisterly in the desert sun, every movement of its pincers an omen of death. Its stinger, as deadly as a poisoned blade, swings above its head, ready to strike anyone who dares to approach.
CREATURE.sectateursuicidaire.description: A suicidal cultist, his gaze is void of all joy, every word he speaks an echo of despair. His determination is as sharp as the dagger he holds, and his demented laughter is a constant reminder of the madness that has consumed him.
CREATURE.sectateurgourou.description: A guru cultist, his gaze is as deep as the abyss, every word he speaks is full of mysteries and promises. His charisma is as captivating as fire, drawing lost souls into his embrace, guiding them on the path of blind devotion.
CREATURE.serpentgeant.description: A giant snake, its sinuous body moves with silent grace, each movement a deadly dance of precision and power. Its eyes, cold and calculating, stare at its prey with paralyzing intensity, while its venomous fangs promise a quick and painful death.
CREATURE.shoggoth.description: A shoggoth, its amorphous form moves with unspeakable horror, each pulse a reminder of the abomination it represents. His presence is an insult to reality itself, and simply looking at him can drive the strongest minds into madness.
CREATURE.shoggoth.desarmer.description: (Dexterity ou Strength) the shoggoth absorbs your weapon
CREATURE.squelette.description: A skeleton, his emaciated body a grim reminder of mortality, every movement he makes a grinding of bone on bone. Its empty eye sockets stare into eternity, and the sinister glow that shines within them is an omen of doom to those who cross its path.
CREATURE.squelettearcher.description: A skeleton archer, his gaunt body a sinister silhouette in the darkness, each arrow he shoots a deadly whistle through the air. Its empty eye sockets stare at its target with terrifying precision, and the sinister glow that shines within it is an omen of doom to those who cross its path.
CREATURE.squelettecavalier.description: In the shadows, an echo of clicking resonates. He is a skeleton rider, a figure of bone and darkness, wielding a fearsome spear, traversing eternity on his spectral steed.
CREATURE.troll.description: Under the open sky, a low rumble is heard. It is a Troll, an imposing figure, emerging from the depths of the earth, its sharp claws ready to tear the silence.
CREATURE.tyrannosaure.description: Under the bright sky, a roar rang out. It is a tyrannosaurus, an imposing silhouette, emerging from prehistory, its sharp claws and powerful jaw ready to tear the silence.
CREATURE.tyrannosaure.morsure.descriptio: (Dexterity or Melee) the target is swallowed the next turn
CREATURE.vampirejeune.description: Under the moonlight, a chill runs through the air. It is a young vampire, an elegant figure, emerging from eternity, his sharp fangs ready to taste the sweetness of the night.
CREATURE.vampirejeune.morsure.descriptio: (Dexterity or Melee) infected, the vampire will be able to find you wherever you are
CREATURE.vampireaine.description: Under the veil of night, an ancient presence is felt. He is an elder vampire, a majestic figure, emerging from centuries past, his sharp fangs ready to savor eternity.
CREATURE.vampireaine.regardparalysant.de: (Guts) paralyzed until the end of your next turn
CREATURE.vergeant.description: Under the cloudless sky, a tremor runs through the earth. It is a giant worm, a monstrous silhouette, emerging from the bowels of the earth, its segmented body ready to devour the world.
CREATURE.vergeant.engloutir.description: (Dexterity) you are digested by the giant worm after 3 turnss
CREATURE.vergeant.tremblementdeterre.des: (Dexterity) disadvantage to your attribute rolls on your next turn.
CREATURE.zombie.description: In the silence of the night, a sinister creaking sound is heard. It is a zombie, a fleshless figure, emerging from the grave, its decomposed hands ready to seize the world of the living.
CREATURE.zombie.morsure.description: (Dexterity or Melee) infected, turns into a zombie in two days if the wound is not treated properly (at the GM's discretion)
ATTRIBUT.force.description: Represents both physical strength and endurance.
ATTRIBUT.charisme.description: Represents the ability to influence others in conversation.
ATTRIBUT.sang-froid.description: Represents remaining calm in the face of horror, the unspeakable, or a suspicious guard.
ATTRIBUT.erudition.description: Represents general knowledge (a score below 10 means a character is illiterate).
ATTRIBUT.melee.description: Represents the ability to inflict harm in close combat.
ATTRIBUT.tir.description: Represents the ability to kill from afar.
PEUPLE.libelle.vous-avez-grandi: You grew up or received your education...
PEUPLE.elfe.education.1: Under the tutelage of a high council member.
PEUPLE.elfe.education.2: With storytellers from the House of Memories.
PEUPLE.elfe.education.3: While trying to join the royal scouts' regiment.
PEUPLE.elfe.education.4: While protecting the borders of your kingdom.
PEUPLE.elfe.education.5: In the corridors of the House of Arts.
PEUPLE.nain.education.2: In the stinking mushroom fields of your city.
PEUPLE.nain.education.3: As an apprentice in a forge.
PEUPLE.nain.education.4: Under the blows of the mine guardians' instructors.
PEUPLE.nain.education.5: As an initiate of a master craftsman.
PEUPLE.nain.education.6: At the bottom of a mine, pickaxe in hand.
PEUPLE.gobelin.education.2: In a horde led by gorelings.
PEUPLE.gobelin.education.4: Under the whip of a dwarf foreman.
PEUPLE.gobelin.education.6: As an initiate of an assassin's order.
PEUPLE.ogre.education.1: The docks of the local port.
PEUPLE.ogre.education.3: The books you were fond of.
PEUPLE.ogre.education.6: The band of a mercenary troop.
CRIME.libelle.vous-etes-accuse: You had to leave your home because you have been accused of...
CRIME.crime-de-base.accusation.11: Killing a member of your family.
CRIME.crime-de-base.accusation.13: Burning down the house of a nobleman.
CRIME.crime-de-base.accusation.16: Making a pact with a demon.
CRIME.crime-de-base.accusation.20: To have hunted on a royal reserve.
PROFESSION.libelle.pour-survivre: To survive, you relied on the profession...
PROFESSION.violence.profession.1.descrip: Increase the size of your damage die by one.
PROFESSION.violence.profession.2.descrip: Double your damage when you attack with surprise.
PROFESSION.violence.profession.3.descrip: Your bare hands do as much damage as your weapon (your two damage dice are identical).
PROFESSION.violence.profession.4.descrip: Critical successes inflict damage equal to your Dexterity.
PROFESSION.violence.profession.5.descrip: You can use Strength instead of Charisma to intimidate or persuade your opponents.
PROFESSION.violence.profession.6.descrip: You can absorb damage intended for an adjacent character, dividing the damage by two in that case.
PROFESSION.isolement.profession.1.descri: Increase the size of your damage die by one.
PROFESSION.isolement.profession.2.descri: You can take long rests when far from civilization.
PROFESSION.isolement.profession.3.descri: Your first arrow always finds its target. Add your level to this arrow’s damage.
PROFESSION.isolement.profession.4.descri: You have advantage on initiative rolls.
PROFESSION.isolement.profession.5.descri: You are less affected by things of this world. You have advantage on Panic rolls.
PROFESSION.isolement.profession.6.descri: You gain advantage on Fear rolls. Roll your damage die twice when fighting the undead.
Few locks resist you. You have advantage on all attribute rolls related to climbing, lockpicking, and stealth.
You can choose the move action twice without rolling Willpower. You are able to memorize everything you hear (with a successful Willpower roll).
With a successful Charisma roll, your target believes one of your lies for one hour (once per target!).
You are immune to poisons and most diseases.
You always have a knife on you which escapes searches. When you buy equipment, roll a d4 instead of a d6.
Gain advantage on all attribute rolls to avoid traps or area effect.
PROFESSION.erudition.profession.1.descri: You can restore [d4 + your level] HP to a patient with a successful Dexterity roll.
PROFESSION.erudition.profession.2.descri: Your character knows two randomly determined spells.
PROFESSION.erudition.profession.3.descri: Create d4 potions after a long rest. Your unused potions expire within a day. Potion examples: healing balms (2 HP), anti-poison (induces vomiting), anti-venom (cancels the effects of venom), poison (inflicts the herbalist's damage die)...
PROFESSION.erudition.profession.4.descri: You know two additional languages and can always make yourself understood (if the person you are speaking to also makes an effort). If your first action in combat is to talk to your opponents, you act first.
PROFESSION.erudition.profession.5.descri: You may roll Erudition in place of any other attribute once per session. You must justify this by citing a historical fact (concocted by yourself).
PROFESSION.erudition.profession.6.descri: Choose a resource at the beginning of each session (ammunition, rations, etc.). The usage die for this resource only degrades on a result of 1 for all characters in the group.
TALENT.acharne.description: Once per session, add your Willpower die to your damage.
TALENT.adepte-magie-sang.description: When a character casts a spell, they can ignore a disadvantage on their Willpower roll by sacrificing 2 HP.
TALENT.ange-mort.description: In combat, you gain a critical success on a natural result of 1 to 3.
TALENT.charognard.description: When a human dies near you, you get 1 HP back (but only once per turn).
TALENT.coriace.description: If you are still alive after biting the dust, add your level to the HP you recover.
TALENT.couture-cicatrices.description: When you aren't wearing armor, you are considered to have a natural PR of 1.
TALENT.cuistot.description: Once per session, you can concoct a tasty meal that gives the benefits of a long rest to a short rest. You must have the necessary ingredients for your meal.
TALENT.dangereux.description: When you successfully defend yourself in combat, your attacker loses 1 HP.
TALENT.debrouillard.description: Once per session, you can bring any single usage die (other than the Willpower die) up to its maximum.
TALENT.duelliste.description: Each turn, you have the choice between two options: gain advantage on either their damage or their defense roll. If this fails, the character must make a Willpower roll (with disadvantage in case of a critical failure).
TALENT.fetichiste.description: Choose one of your weapons to now inflict d12 points of damage. However a result of 1 on the damage die means that it breaks. If this occurs, you must spend a week to transfer this advantage to a new weapon.
TALENT.foutu-veinard.description: Once per session, ignore the damage caused by an attack by sacrificing a weapon, piece of armor, or shield.
TALENT.hante.description: Your nightmares sometimes contain a warning of what to expect. Once per session, you can act first (whether or not in combat).
TALENT.impassible.description: You can return your Willpower die to its maximum after a short rest.
TALENT.increvable.description: You gain advantage when rolling on the Helpless table.
TALENT.meticuleux.description: Usage dice tied to your gear only degrade on a result of 1.
TALENT.paranoiaque.description: You gain advantage on your Initiative rolls.
TALENT.parcimonieux.description: You gain advantage on rolls to determine the cost of an item. For example, if an item costs d6x100 shillings, you roll 2d6 and keep the lower result (if you are the buyer) or the higher result (if you are the seller).
TALENT.protecteur.description: Once per fight, you can cancel d6 points of damage intended for an adjacent character.
TALENT.rassurant.description: Once per scene or fight, the character grants one of his companions advantage on a Guts roll.
TALENT.roi-evasion.description: You are able to escape any type of bond with a successful Dexterity roll.
TALENT.rat-bibliotheque.description: Replace any attribute roll with an Erudition roll once per session (twice if you are a Chronicler). You must justify this by citing the book's title and author (make a small list before each session).
TALENT.rancunier.description: If an attack brings you to 0 HP, you can immediately attack with advantage before collapsing.
TALENT.resolu.description: You gain advantage to resist your opponent's spells.
TALENT.sanguinaire.description: The size of your damage die increases by one.
TALENT.suicidaire.description: You can choose to have your melee attack be an automatic success, but all your Defense rolls will fail on your turn.
TALENT.opiniatre.description: Once per day, you can recover a number of HP equal to your level, even in the middle of a fight.
TALENT.tacticien.description: Once per battle, you can sacrifice your turn and give it to an adjacent companion.
TALENT.touche-obscur.description: You gain advantage when you roll on the Chaos Revenge table.
SORT.berceuse-lugubre.description: Your target loses consciousness. A result of 1 on the Willpower die means that the target will not wake up.
SORT.combustion-spontanee.description: Your target bursts into flames and suffers continuous damage. A result of 1 on the Willpower die means that everyone present will burst into flames.
SORT.cri-infernal.description: An inhuman scream paralyzes those who hear it for a few seconds. This spell kills children and pets instantly.
SORT.fantome-acier.description: Renders a weapon no longer than a dagger completely invisible until it is drawn from its scabbard (or the wizard casts another spell). If the weapon does not injure anyone on the turn it is drawn, the wizard loses d6 HP.
SORT.guide-chthonien.description: When you are underground, this spell summons a rat that can guide you to the nearest exit, provided you feed it your blood ( this costs d4 HP). The rat dies once you reach the exit.
SORT.inquisition.description: Your target must be immobilized. The spell subjects him to intense pain and forces him to answer d4 questions. The GM rolls the die and hides the result from the wizard's player. If the player asks more questions than the die roll allows, the person dies.
SORT.main-avide.description: One of the objects your target is holding flies to you. A result of 1 on the Willpower die indicates that the object is destroyed.
SORT.malediction-muet.description: The target can no longer speak. A result of 1 on the Willpower die makes the effect permanent.
SORT.marque-sanglante.description: You can mark an object with a drop of your blood (this definitely costs you 1 HP). You always know where this object is. If the object is destroyed, the sorcerer recovers his HP.
SORT.memoire-defaillante.description: Your target forgets all interactions with you over the last d6 hours. A result of 1 on the Willpower die means that the target becomes totally amnesiac.
SORT.message-onirique.description: Send a message to someone you know through a dream. The target must of course be asleep. This spell has no range limit.
SORT.molosse-infernal.description: Turns an ordinary dog into an infernal hound (11 Attack, 10 HP, bites for d6 damage). The dog dies when the fight is over.
SORT.os-serpent.description: The target's body becomes as flexible as a snake's, allowing it to easily escape from bonds or slip between bars or into a narrow passage. The spell lasts for 6 minutes. A result of 1 on the Willpower die causes the target to lose all its hair (which will grow back in the following days).
SORT.partage-fraternel.description: You can transfer a loss of HP caused by a wound to one of your companions.
SORT.projectile-empoisonne.description: You poison a projectile by dipping it in your own blood (this costs you 1 HP). Anyone wounded by this projectile dies after 4 minutes.
SORT.reflet-vivant.description: You give a semblance of life to your reflection in a mirror. You can see what it sees when you close your eyes (and cannot sleep while the spell is active). The spell stops when you decide to or when the mirror is broken.
SORT.sang-acide.description: You can make a small pool of your blood acidic (it costs 3 HP to create). It causes d6 points of damage to a living creature or can dissolve an object no larger than a small book.
SORT.saut-ange.description: The target escapes without damage from a fall that one might have thought fatal. All equipment worn by the target is irreparably destroyed.
SORT.silence-mort.description: All sounds within a 10 meter radius of the sorcerer are muffled. The spell lasts as long as the wizard can concentrate. A result of 1 on the Willpower die means that all people in the area of effect of the spell become mute for the same duration.
SORT.souffle-demon.description: All light sources in the same room as the sorcerer are immediately extinguished. A fire will also start in another room of the building.
SORT.vin-mort.description: The spells targets a jug or cup of wine the sorcerer must touch. Those who drink this wine quickly start looking for a fight. A result of 1 on the Willpower die means that the drinkers are trying.
SORT.voleur-vie.description: If you manage to hit your target, you 'steal' d6 HP from it, which comes back to replenish your own supply (without making it exceed its maximum). On a result of 1 the target dies.
SORT.voleur-voix.description: You can now speak through your target's mouth. You are limited to six words.
SORT.voile-tenebres.description: One d6 targets are blinded for an entire combat (or d6 minutes). A result of 1 on the Willpower die means that you are also affected.
SORT.yeux-corbeau.description: The sorcerer can see through the eyes of a bird as long as he remains concentrated and keeps his eyes closed. As soon as he opens his eyes, the spell stops and the bird dies.
SORT.carte-du-mort.description: The blood of a dead man draws a map that indicates the rough location of the murderer.
SORT.epouvantail.description: Animates a pile of clothes or rags to give them the appearance of life. Its movements are uncoordinated and the scarecrow cannot hurt anyone.
SORT.flammeche.description: This spell summons a flame (no larger than a match) in the sorcerer's palm. On a result of 1 on the Willpower die, the sorcerer's clothes catch fire.
SORT.flaque-de-boue.description: Immediately slows down any person, animal, or vehicle that steps into it (enough to end a chase, for example).
SORT.fleches-impuissantes.description: All projectiles that hit the target of the spell during the next turn do no damage. On a Willpower die result of 1, the projectiles of the sorcerer's allies are also affected.
SORT.gardien-des-songes.description: Animates a doll, puppet, or stuffed animal that stands guard while you sleep. It starts to scream if it sees someone the wizard has not designated. Lasts one night (the spell does not work during the day).
SORT.lucioles.description: The sorcerer summons a swarm of fireflies that give as much light as a torch. They disappear at the slightest sign of combat.
SORT.marque-de-infamie.description: The target of this spell bears the name of the crime he committed on his forehead. The effectiveness of this spell has yet to be proven among the illiterate. The mark fades at the next dawn. On a result of 1, the sign appears on the foreheads of all those present.
SORT.nuee-abeilles.description: The target is stung several times (d3 damage) and cannot act during this turn.
SORT.parfum-de-la-campagne.description: The target gives off the smell of manure until next dawn.
SORT.repas-du-croyant.description: The sorcerer purifies a meal (poisons, natural or not, are eliminated) but it no longer has any flavor. A successful Guts roll is required to eat it.
SORT.sac-a-puces.description: The sorcerer can transform himself into a dog, but he only returns to his original form at sunset (if the spell is cast during the day) or at sunrise (if the spell is cast at night). His HP does not change, he can only bite (use his damage with his bare hands) and bark.
TABLE.panique.1: {nom} manages to get a grip and can act normally.
TABLE.panique.2: {nom} screams for one Turn. Everyone hearing this rolls Willpower.
TABLE.panique.4: {nom} suffers from hysterical blindness that lasts the end of the next Turn.
TABLE.panique.5: {nom} randomly attacks someone. If there is no target nearby, he inflicts d4 points of damage on himself.
TABLE.mordrelapoussiere.1: Scarred: {nom} gets away with an ugly scar.
TABLE.mordrelapoussiere.2: Close call: one of the objects carried by {nom} is broken.
TABLE.mordrelapoussiere.3: Impaired: disadvantage to Dexterity rolls until the end of the session.
TABLE.mordrelapoussiere.4: Injured: disadvantage to all attribute rolls until the end of the session.
TABLE.mordrelapoussiere.5: Butchered: {nom} loses 1 point of Strength or Dexterity permanently.
TABLE.mordrelapoussiere.6: Dead: create a new character of the same level as the dead {nom}.
TABLE.revancheduchaos.description: If your Will die is depleted after casting a spell, you face a revenge of Chaos.
TABLE.revancheduchaos.1: You cannot cast any more spells until next sunrise.
TABLE.revancheduchaos.2: The energy of the spell ravages your body: lose d6 HP.
TABLE.revancheduchaos.3: You cause an explosion of magical energy: inflict d6 points of damage to all nearby.
TABLE.revancheduchaos.4: Your body pays the price of your arrogance: lose 1 HP permanently.
TABLE.revancheduchaos.5: Your mind is consumed by horrors from beyond: lose 1 point of Guts permanently.
TABLE.revancheduchaos.6: A creature from another dimension appears and drags you into their domain.

FORMULAIRE.personnage.libelle.affamesale: If the character prefers to stay hungry and dirty, he will suffer Disadvantage on all of his rolls during this game, which will teach you to be a pincher.

FORMULAIRE.equipement.libelle.armetueuse: This type of weapon inflicts maximum damage on a successful attack against its target of choice (vampires, leechers, undead, etc.).
FORMULAIRE.equipement.libelle.acierilmar: Ilmarian steel is the strongest material available. Unfortunately, the secret of its manufacture has been lost and weapons made of this steel are very rare. A weapon made of Ilmarian steel inflicts 1 extra point of damage.
FORMULAIRE.equipement.libelle.accordeava: An item of this type can grant Advantage to a specific type of action, such as a cloak of concealment which grants Advantage to any Dexterity check dedicated to stealth.
FORMULAIRE.equipement.libelle.accordeenc: An object of this type can grant the effect of a spell (in this case the object has a d6 of use).
